means.example-sentence: On a long autumn night, many people yearn for the hometown they left a long time ago.
means.sentence-jp: 秋の夜長には、多くの人々は遠い昔に後にした故郷を恋しがる。

cloze.maskedText: On a long autumn night, many people ____ the hometown they left a long time ago.

notes: yearn after ~, yearn to do も同じ意味だが、いずれも文学的な表現。long, desire が口語的。
